messages:
mia: Hi team — newborn arrived via surrogacy last week 🎉. Trying to add the baby to benefits but the birth certificate lists the gestational carrier and not our names yet. What docs do you need for enrollment?

sasha - People Ops: Congrats, mia! :tada: For surrogacy cases we typically accept one of the following (pick whichever you have):
- Court-issued parentage/parental order naming you as the legal parent(s)
- Hospital letter + evidence of intended parent agreement or surrogacy contract (if court order pending)
- Birth certificate once it’s been amended to list you

We also need the child’s DOB and SSN when available. Please upload to the HR portal under Benefits > Dependent Docs. Link: https://hr.redwood.example.com/upload (choose category: "Newborn - Surrogacy")

peopleops_bot: Case created: #BP-3489. A People Ops rep will follow up within 2 business days.

jamal: Quick Q — timeline? If the court paperwork takes months, is there any retro coverage option?

sasha - People Ops: Good Q. You have 60 days from the child’s date of birth to add them as a qualifying life event (QLE). If you expect official docs to be delayed past that, upload any provisional docs (hospital letter + surrogacy agreement) within the 60-day window and mark the submission as "pending court order." We can provisionally enroll the child and bill retro premiums once the official docs arrive. If documents miss the 60-day window, we can still submit an exception request to benefits carrier, but approval isn’t guaranteed.

alex: For payroll — will premiums be prorated if we enroll after the first of the month?

sasha - People Ops: Yes, premiums are prorated based on the coverage start date. If we enroll mid-pay-period, payroll will show a prorated deduction on the next payroll run. We’ll confirm the effective date when you submit the docs.

mia: Thanks. One more — our names differ from the gestational carrier on hospital paperwork. Will that be an issue?

sasha - People Ops: Not an issue. The common pattern: upload hospital letter + surrogacy contract showing intended parents + any interim legal filing. If the carrier requires a court order later, we’ll replace the provisional docs with the final order. If you want, DM me the case number and I’ll flag it for priority review.

jamal: Thx — tagging for visibility in case other folks run into this: @sasha - People Ops :thumbsup:

mia: Uploading docs now. Thanks everyone!

peopleops_bot: Reminder: please redact any sensitive banking/payment info before uploading.
